title: IFS partners with Riyadh-based Echelon for the Saudi market
summary: Echelon, an AI transformation firm headquartered in Riyadh, will deploy and localise IFS.ai for Saudi enterprises in energy, manufacturing, oil and gas, aerospace and defence, logistics and telecoms.

title: Building envelope contractor Flynn selects IFS Cloud
summary: Flynn Group of Companies, a North American contractor with more than 6,000 employees, chose IFS Cloud including CRM and EAM, and plans to use IFS Loops digital workers to automate accounts payable.

title: JumpModel and Gogh Solutions now operate as Coredrive
summary: The two North American IFS services firms, whose combination with investment from Superstep Capital was announced in April 2026, have adopted a single name, Coredrive.

title: IFS Unleashed runs 12 to 16 October in Orlando
summary: IFS's annual customer and partner event takes place in Orlando. Softeon, the warehouse management business IFS acquired, appears for the first time with sessions and a preview of AI features.

title: Flexicode Group acquires Danish IFS partner Curit
summary: Flexicode is buying 100% of Curit, a Danish IFS partner founded in 2003 with more than 50 customers. It follows Flexicode's combination with Finland's Aveso. The group reports about 200 IFS specialists.

title: Addovation and SEBSA plan a partnership pooling IFS specialists
summary: Nordic IFS partner Addovation (200+ experts) and SEBSA (100+ experts) announced plans for a partnership covering IFS strategy, implementation, migration and managed services.

title: IFS research points digital workers at the industrial capacity gap
summary: IFS-commissioned research found 77% of decision-makers delayed or skipped an initiative for lack of capacity. Kitron plans digital workers at all 13 sites by the end of 2026.

title: Serrala and IFS partner on finance automation in IFS Cloud
summary: Serrala and IFS formed a partnership to bring AI-based finance automation into IFS Cloud, targeting manual accounts payable and receivable work and cash flow visibility.

title: IFS reports H1 2026 recurring revenue up 25%
summary: For the first half of 2026 IFS reported annual recurring revenue up 25% year on year, cloud revenue up 24%, and recurring revenue at 84% of total revenue.

title: IFS industrial AI demo featured in Microsoft Experience Centers
summary: A digital worker scenario handling a packaging-line failure is shown at Microsoft Experience Centers in Munich, Silicon Valley and Singapore. IFS Cloud runs on Microsoft Azure.

title: Chelsea FC to deploy IFS in finance and procurement
summary: Chelsea Football Club signed a multi-year agreement to use IFS technology, starting with finance and procurement, with asset management and facility operations planned later.

title: 1898 & Co. and IFS partner on utility asset management
summary: 1898 & Co., the consultancy arm of Burns & McDonnell, announced a partnership with IFS combining its utility expertise with IFS asset and work management software.

title: IFS Cloud 26R1 released with IFS Zero emissions management
summary: The 26R1 release adds IFS Zero for Scope 1, 2 and 3 emissions, service projects and commercial contract management, permit-to-work controls and aviation maintenance updates.

title: IFS appoints Ryan Courson as Chief Financial Officer
summary: Ryan Courson, previously COO and CFO at Kaseya, succeeds Matthias Heiden as IFS CFO. The announcement cited Q1 2026 recurring revenue growth of 25%.
